Default code language annotation on blocks without lang attribute

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<pre><code>def hello(): pass</code></pre>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(code_language: 'python'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
